 About the match
 On this page you can find the Al Shorta vs Al-Hussein match lineup for AFC Champions League Two — Round 3 - First Leg, on Tuesday 27-10-2026, along with the substitutes and the players missing from the squad. Al Shorta lines up in a 4-2-3-1 led by Hassan, while Al-Hussein sets up in a 5-4-1 led by Al-Kawamleh. Al Shorta is led by head coach Hussein Abdulwahid, while Al-Hussein is managed by Curro Torres. The match is played at Al Zawra Stadium.
